nom: Neutrogena Deep Clean Gentle Daily Facial Scrub

avis.titre: Best daily facial scrub, love this classic!
avis.texte: Neutrogena Deep Clean Gentle Facial Scrub is a staple in my skincare routine! It gently exfoliates without irritating the skin, leaving my face feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed. Oil-free formula is perfect for everyday use. It doesn't strip moisture but really removes dirt and buildup effectively. I've used it for years and nothing else compares. Great size and great value. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a reliable daily cleanser!

I like this as a scrub, bit it's not a face "cleaner". It has no lather; I actually combine it with a cleanser that lathers for dual action cleaning/scrubbing. Alone, it scrubs nicely. For me, it has just the right amount of microbeads to provide a gentle scrub for in between use of an electronic scrubber and great for travel.

avis.titre: Excellent Deep Clean Cleanser That Is Actually Gentle on Skin
avis.texte: Excellent cleanser without being harsh on my sensitive skin. My face felt so great afterwards. Slight fragrance is very pleasant too.
It's gentle but exfoliates and I feel like my face is really clean. It has a nice fragrance.

I like my facial scrub. Thus is a very good product to lift dirt, and clean your face. It does not have a strong scent, and its good for my dry skin. I will be buying more. Thank you. Cheaper on Amazon, then some stores.

I really like this Neutrogena face wash! It feels gentle but still leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh. I like that it’s oil-free and has a light exfoliating feel without being too harsh. Great for everyday use, and the 4.2 oz size is perfect. Definitely happy with it!
Buen Producto de verdad mantiene la piel limpia y sin hacer daño. Su uso constante es bastante bueno para mantener los poros de la piel limpios.
Great product; has helped my skin tremendously. Perfect for very sensitive skin like mine!
Maravilloso, me deja la cara super limpia y suave, con un olor muy agradable.
I love how gentle this exfoliating scrub is on my face. I have sensitive skin and it doesn’t burn and doesn’t dry my skin out. A must in my skincare routine. I highly recommend.
Don’t know why the packaging is like that, don’t look too good but it did its job i guess. Great product tho!

Smells citrus-y, like oranges. I didn't think this would really help me because I'm prone to breakouts normally. The beads are gentle, I'm a bit concerned that they don't dissolve and feel guilty for whatever they might be made out of but my skin is clear, and bright even. I changed my usual hormone dosage a couple of months ago and have only broken out from hair removal since! I tried to make this same change about two years ago and immediately broke out with incredibly itchy, painful cystic acne along my jaw and had to go back to my usual hormone dose. I've always trusted the brand. I use this and their oil free moisturizer daily, their sensitive skin wipes in a pinch and j&j baby shampoo for make up remover (mountain falls I'm trying this month, we'll see). The combo has been working well for about 4 months now.

avis.titre: Exfoliante para todo tipo de piel!
avis.texte: Este exfoliante no puede faltar en tu vidaaaaa! Lo amoooo. Es una de mis marcas favoritas. Utilizo casi todo de ellos. Esto es oroooo, olor, textura, lo tiene todo.

This is a great daily exfoliator! I've used it for over 20 years. People never believe my age (over 50) and ask what products I use and this is one of them. I recommend being very careful in the beginning because it can be harsh on your skin, so go lightly at first. First. Then over time your skin will get used to it and exfoliate nicely removing a thin layer everyday. My skin is super smooth. It's like a microderm abrasion in a tube.

avis.titre: Love it. Smells good, smoothing, clearing, worth it.
avis.texte: This is my favorite skincare brand especially the face wash. This is my first time buying this one in a very long time, I love it. It smells so good and makes my skin so smooth and clear within the first use without feeling rough. Great for sensitive skin. A little goes a long way, worth the price.
This scrub is literally the best, it doesn't irritate the skin and it actually works quickly. It's working for me and I think it can work for you so go ahead and order this today.

Product has been completely reformulated and the ingredients no longer match what is described above. For instance, jojoba is no longer an ingredient. The reformulated product doesn’t smell as good, feels greasy and is difficult to wash off, and is not something I will use going forward. Have used this for years and wonder why it was changed when so many loyal customers like myself loved this cleanser the way it was.

avis.titre: Long time user; new formula DOES NOT WORK
avis.texte: I’ve used this product for like 15 years. I have oily skin and it always cleaned my face and left me feeling great after my shower EVERY MORNING. They just reformulated it and removed most of the original ingredients. BIG mistake - it no longer works and leaves by face feeling oily and gross every morning. Epic fail! I’m actively looking for a replacement product - if you know of one please post a review and mention it. I’m looking at using Cetaphil Daily Facial Cleanser? Any thoughts?
This Product was unsealed and half empty. Can't believe they shipped this. Now, I have to drive to drop off faulty item. Hopefully they won't send it out to another person

avis.titre: New formula! False advertising on amazon
avis.texte: The original formula was replaced with this one that is much worse for your skin. Note that alcohol is the second ingredient. Amazon needs to change their advertising if this is the product they are now sending.
